description: This PHP source file contains a migration class for the OrangeHRM system, specifically applying database schema updates for version 4.5.0. It defines methods to set up and modify database tables related to OAuth scopes, clients, and API usage tracking.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: Migration class for applying database schema updates in the OrangeHRM system for version 4.5.0, extending the AbstractMigration base class.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs schema changes such as creating tables and altering existing tables by adding columns, and setting default values, to upgrade the database to version 4.5.0.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string '4.5' denoting this migration's version.
